info.name: Automation With Rohit - Practice API
info.description:
Practice REST API for GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

Start the server with `node server.js`, import this collection and the environment, then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (requests are ordered so they pass top to bottom).

Login: admin / admin@1234

exec: pm.expect(responseData.token_type, `Expected token_type: Bearer, Actual token_type: ${responseData.token_type}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.eql("Bearer");
pm.expect(responseData.user.username, `Expected user.username: admin, Actual user.username: ${responseData.user.username}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.eql("admin");
pm.expect(responseData.user.role, `Expected user.role: admin, Actual user.role: ${responseData.user.role}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.eql("admin");
// Save values for the next requests

request.description: Returns a Bearer token valid for 24 hours. The test saves it to {{token}}.

exec: pm.expect(responseData.error, `Expected error to include: Invalid username or password, Actual error: ${responseData.error}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.include("Invalid username or password");
pm.expect(responseData.error, `Expected error to include: required, Actual error: ${responseData.error}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.include("required");
pm.expect(responseData.error, `Expected error to include: locked, Actual error: ${responseData.error}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.include("locked");
pm.expect(responseData.username, `Expected username: admin, Actual username: ${responseData.username}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.eql("admin");
pm.expect(responseData.data.length, `Expected at most 10 users, Actual: ${responseData.data.length}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.be.at.most(10);

pm.expect(responseData.message, `Expected message: ${`User ${pm.collectionVariables.get("userId")} deleted successfully`}, Actual message: ${responseData.message}, Response_Body: ${JSON.stringify(responseData)}`).to.eql(`User ${pm.collectionVariables.get("userId")} deleted successfully`);
